To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the impact of Parker grades is positive, significant and economically meaningful.

(i) Robert Parker's wine grades have a positive impact on en primeur prices; (ii) the impact of a grade increase on prices is greater the lower the grade; (iii) the impact of Parker's grades is larger the later the grade is published, and (iv) Parker's impact on the market is larger the less information the market has about the wines.
